# rustinion_device_display_name (Resource)

Sets a device's display name: shown instead of the agent-reported hostname in device lists, alerts and digest emails (the hostname stays visible beside it unless the name already contains it). Destroying this resource clears it, so the hostname is used again.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The device.
- `display_name` (String) The display name, 1-120 characters.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The hostname the agent reports.
- `id` (String) Same as device_id.
- `name` (String) What the product calls the device: the display name, with the hostname in brackets unless the name already contains it.
